definition_en: a sweet brown food made from cocoa
core_image: 一块棕色巧克力放在桌上，旁边是一杯热可可
scene: 桌上放着一块棕色巧克力，旁边是一杯热可可。She breaks the chocolate into squares.
sceneCN: 这里 chocolate 是「巧克力」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她把巧克力掰成方块。

senses.title: The sweet food made from cacao
senses.definition: a sweet brown food made from cacao beans
senses.definitionCN: 用可可豆做成的棕色甜食
senses.example: She breaks the chocolate into squares.
senses.why: Chocolate came into English through Spanish, from a Nahuatl word for a bitter cacao drink, and it now names the sweet food made from cacao.
senses.whyCN: chocolate 经西班牙语进入英语，源自阿兹特克语里一种苦味可可饮料的名字，现在指可可做成的甜食。

senses.title: One small sweet of this kind
senses.definition: a single small sweet made of chocolate
senses.definitionCN: 一颗用巧克力做的小糖
senses.example: He gave her a box of chocolates.
senses.exampleCN: 他送给她一盒巧克力糖。
senses.why: A single piece can be counted, so a chocolate is one sweet and chocolates are the pieces in a box.
senses.whyCN: 单块的巧克力可以数，所以 a chocolate 就是一颗糖，chocolates 就是一盒里的那些块。

senses.title: A hot drink made with chocolate
senses.definition: a hot drink made by melting chocolate in milk or water
senses.definitionCN: 把巧克力化在牛奶或水里做成的热饮
senses.example: A cup of hot chocolate warms the hands.
senses.why: Melted chocolate mixed with milk becomes a drink, and the same word covers that hot drink.
senses.whyCN: 化开的巧克力兑上牛奶就成了饮料，同一个词也指这种热饮。

items.en: Cacahuatl named the cocoa bean.
items.cn: 阿兹特克语 cacahuatl 指可可豆。

items.en: Spanish brought the word to Europe.
items.cn: 西班牙语把这个词带到欧洲。

items.en: English kept it for the food and drink.
items.cn: 英语用它指这种食物与饮料。

items.en: Sugar turned the drink into a solid sweet.
items.cn: 加糖后饮料变成块状甜食。

items.en: Chocolate names sweets, drinks and colours.
items.cn: 现代英语中它指糖果、饮料与颜色。

core_image: 一双木筷搁在瓷碗上，碗里是热气腾腾的面条
scene: 一双木筷搁在瓷碗上，碗里是热气腾腾的面条。He holds the chopsticks in one hand.
sceneCN: 这里 chopstick 是「筷子」（第 01 个义项）；句意是他一只手拿着筷子。

senses.title: One of a pair of sticks used for eating
senses.definition: one of a pair of thin sticks used to lift food
senses.definitionCN: 成对使用、用来夹取食物的细棍
senses.example: He holds the chopsticks in one hand.
senses.why: Chopstick joins chop, from the pidgin 'chop-chop' meaning quick, with stick: the quick sticks used at a Chinese meal.
senses.whyCN: chopstick 由 chop 和 stick 合成；chop 来自洋泾浜英语 chop-chop「快」，指中餐里那双取食很快的棍子。

senses.title: Used before a noun, meaning 'for chopsticks'
senses.definition: placed before another noun to mean 'used with chopsticks'
senses.definitionCN: 放在另一名词前，表示配筷子使用的
senses.example: The chopstick rest holds each pair neatly.
senses.exampleCN: 筷架把每一双筷子放得整整齐齐。
senses.why: English lets a noun modify another noun, so chopstick before rest marks the object that serves the chopsticks.
senses.whyCN: 英语允许名词修饰名词，所以 chopstick rest 里的 chopstick 标明这件东西是给筷子用的。

definition_en: a group of students taught together, or a lesson
core_image: 一间教室里学生们坐在课桌前，老师在黑板上写字
scene: 教室里学生们坐在课桌前，老师在黑板上写字。Our class has twenty students.
sceneCN: 这里 class 是「班级」（第 01 个义项）；句意是我们班有二十名学生。

senses.title: A group of students taught together
senses.definition: a group of students who are taught together
senses.definitionCN: 一起上课的一群学生
senses.example: Our class has twenty students.
senses.why: Class came from Latin classis, a group sorted by rank; in a school it became the group of pupils taught together.
senses.whyCN: class 来自拉丁语 classis「按等级划分的群体」，在学校里就指一起受教的一群学生。

senses.title: A lesson or period of teaching
senses.definition: a period of teaching in a subject
senses.definitionCN: 某一科目的一节教学时段
senses.example: We have English class at nine.
senses.why: The group and the hour it sits down to learn share one name, so class also means the lesson itself.
senses.whyCN: 这一群学生和他们坐下来学习的那个时段共用一个名字，所以 class 也指课本身。

senses.title: A social rank or group
senses.definition: a group in society sharing a similar rank or income
senses.definitionCN: 社会中地位或收入相近的一群人
senses.example: The working class grew in the cities.
senses.exampleCN: 工人阶级在城市里壮大起来。
senses.why: Latin classis already sorted people into ranks, and that older sense survives as the social meaning of class.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 classis 本来就把人按等级划分，这层古老的意思保留下来，成了 class 的社会含义。

senses.title: A category in a system of grouping
senses.definition: a group in a system that sorts living things or objects
senses.definitionCN: 生物或事物分类体系中的一级
senses.example: Whales belong to the same class as mammals.
senses.exampleCN: 鲸与哺乳动物属于同一个纲。
senses.why: Sorting things into ranked groups is the original work of class, so science also uses it for a category.
senses.whyCN: 把事物分成有层级的群，本来是 class 的工作，所以科学分类也用它指一个类别。

definition_en: a room where lessons are taught
core_image: 一间明亮的教室，墙上贴着学生的画，课桌排成几行
scene: 一间明亮的教室墙上贴着学生的画，课桌排成几行。The classroom is quiet before the bell.
sceneCN: 这里 classroom 是「教室」（第 01 个义项）；句意是铃响前教室很安静。

senses.title: A room where lessons are taught
senses.definition: a room in a school where lessons take place
senses.definitionCN: 学校里上课用的房间
senses.example: The classroom is quiet before the bell.
senses.why: Classroom is class plus room, the room set aside for the class to meet and learn.
senses.whyCN: classroom 是 class 加 room，就是留给班级上课的那间屋。

senses.title: Used before a noun, meaning 'of the classroom'

senses.example: The classroom rules are on the wall.
senses.why: A noun can stand before another noun like an adjective, so classroom in classroom rules marks the setting those rules belong to.
senses.whyCN: 名词可以像形容词一样放在另一名词前，所以 classroom rules 里的 classroom 标明这些规则属于哪个场合。

definition_en: free from dirt, or to remove dirt
core_image: 一块刚擦过的窗玻璃，阳光照进来，玻璃上没有一点灰
scene: 一块刚擦过的窗玻璃，阳光照进来，玻璃上没有一点灰。She cleans the window every morning.
sceneCN: 这里 clean 是「干净的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她每天早上擦窗户。

senses.title: Free from dirt
senses.definition: not dirty, with no marks or dust on it
senses.definitionCN: 不脏、没有灰尘或污迹
senses.example: The kitchen is clean after washing.
senses.why: Clean goes back to Old English clǣne, 'clear, pure', and freedom from dirt is the word's centre.
senses.whyCN: clean 来自古英语 clǣne「洁净、纯粹」，不沾脏东西是它的核心。

senses.title: To remove dirt from something
senses.definition: to remove dirt from something by washing or wiping
senses.definitionCN: 通过洗、擦把脏东西去掉
senses.example: She cleans the window every morning.
senses.why: The adjective turned into a verb, so clean names the work of making something clean.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转作动词，clean 表示把某物弄干净这项工作。

senses.title: Complete and leaving nothing behind
senses.definition: complete, with nothing left out
senses.definitionCN: 彻底、一点也不剩
senses.example: They made a clean sweep of the prizes.
senses.why: Something swept clean leaves no scrap behind on the floor, so clean also means 'complete, with nothing left'.
senses.whyCN: 扫得干干净净的地上不留一片碎屑，所以 clean 也表示「彻底、一点不剩」。

definition_en: quick to learn or understand things
core_image: 一个小男孩盯着打乱的拼图，很快把最后一块放到位
scene: 一个小男孩盯着打乱的拼图，很快把最后一块放到位。She is clever at solving puzzles.
sceneCN: 这里 clever 是「聪明的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是她很会解谜。

senses.title: Quick to learn and understand
senses.definition: quick at learning, understanding or solving problems
senses.definitionCN: 学得快、想得明白、会解决问题
senses.example: She is clever at solving puzzles.
senses.why: Clever came from an English dialect word for deft or handy, and the idea of a quick, able mind grew out of that handiness.
senses.whyCN: clever 来自英格兰方言里表示「灵巧、手巧」的词，脑子转得快这层意思就是从那分灵巧长出来的。

senses.title: Ingenious, of an idea or plan
senses.definition: skilfully thought out and effective
senses.definitionCN: 想得巧、办法管用
senses.example: That was a clever idea.
senses.why: A plan that works with little effort looks as deft as a clever hand, so the word also praises an ingenious idea.
senses.whyCN: 一个省力又管用的办法，看起来就像灵巧的手，所以这个词也用来称赞巧妙的点子。

senses.title: Cunning rather than honest
senses.definition: skilful in a way that is tricky or not quite honest
senses.definitionCN: 机巧得近乎滑头、不太老实
senses.example: He won with a clever trick.
senses.exampleCN: 他用一个狡猾的把戏赢了。
senses.why: The same quickness can be turned toward tricking people, and then clever describes cunning instead of intelligence.
senses.whyCN: 同样的机敏也可以用来算计别人，这时 clever 形容的是狡猾而不是聪明。

items.en: Clever first meant handy or nimble.
items.cn: 中古英语中 clever 最初指手巧、灵活。

items.en: It moved from hands to the mind.
items.cn: 词义从手上功夫转向头脑。

items.en: Clever now praises quick understanding.
items.cn: 现代英语中 clever 称赞理解得快。

items.en: It also describes neat plans and devices.
items.cn: 它也形容巧妙的计划与装置。

senses.title: To go up using the hands and feet
senses.definition: to move upward, using the hands and feet or a steep path
senses.definitionCN: 手脚并用或沿陡路向上移动
senses.example: They climb the hill before sunrise.
senses.why: Climb goes back to Old English climban, and upward movement with effort is the word's plainest action.
senses.whyCN: climb 来自古英语 climban，费力向上移动是它最朴素的动作。

senses.title: To rise steadily in amount
senses.definition: to rise steadily in price, number or level
senses.definitionCN: 价格、数量或水平持续向上走
senses.example: Prices climbed all summer.
senses.exampleCN: 整个夏天价格都在上涨。
senses.why: A rising figure moves upward the way a climber does, so the climbing verb also describes steady increase.
senses.whyCN: 上升的数字像攀登者一样往上走，所以这个攀爬的动词也描述持续增长。

senses.title: An ascent, as a noun
senses.definition: one act of going up something steep
senses.definitionCN: 一次向上的攀行
senses.example: It was a long climb to the top.
senses.exampleCN: 爬到山顶是一段很长的攀登。
senses.why: The verb turned into a noun, so a climb counts one ascent.
senses.whyCN: 动词转作名词，a climb 就是数一次向上的攀登。

definition_en: a device that shows the time
core_image: 墙上的圆钟指针指向七点，窗外的天刚亮
scene: 墙上的圆钟指针指向七点，窗外的天刚亮。The clock on the wall shows seven.
sceneCN: 这里 clock 是「时钟」（第 01 个义项）；句意是墙上的钟显示七点。

senses.title: An instrument that shows the time
senses.definition: an instrument with a dial or display that shows the time
senses.definitionCN: 带表盘或显示、用来指示时间的器具
senses.example: The clock on the wall shows seven.
senses.why: Clock came from medieval Latin clocca, 'bell', because early clocks announced the hour by ringing; the bell's name passed to the machine.
senses.whyCN: clock 来自中世纪拉丁语 clocca「钟」，因为早期时钟靠敲钟报时，钟的名字就转到了整台机器上。

senses.title: Any instrument with a measuring dial
senses.definition: a meter or dial that measures speed, distance or time
senses.definitionCN: 测量速度、里程或时间的表盘装置
senses.example: The taxi's clock showed the distance travelled.
senses.exampleCN: 出租车的计价表显示行驶的里程。
senses.why: Once the word meant a dial-driven machine, other dial meters such as a taxi's or a car's were also called clocks.
senses.whyCN: 这个词一旦指带表盘的机器，出租车、汽车上的其他表盘也被叫作 clock。

senses.title: To record time, as in clock in
senses.definition: to record one's arrival or departure time on a clock
senses.definitionCN: 用计时器记下上班或下班的时间
senses.example: Workers clock in at eight.
senses.why: The noun turned into a verb, so to clock in is to have the clock record your time.
senses.whyCN: 名词转作动词，clock in 就是让计时器记下你的时间。

senses.definition: the things people wear to cover the body
senses.definitionCN: 穿在身上遮体御寒的物件
senses.example: She puts her clothes away neatly.
senses.why: Clothes is the plural of cloth, 'a piece of fabric', so the word first meant lengths of cloth and came to mean the garments made from them.
senses.whyCN: clothes 是 cloth「一块布」的复数，最初指一块块布料，后来指用布做成的衣物。

senses.title: Used before a noun, meaning 'for clothes'
senses.definition: placed before another noun to mean 'used for clothes'
senses.definitionCN: 放在另一名词前，表示给衣物用的
senses.example: The clothes line hangs behind the house.
senses.why: In compounds such as clothes line, the plural form simply marks what the object is used for.
senses.whyCN: 在 clothes line 这类复合词里，这个复数形式只是标明这件东西是给衣物用的。

scene: 天空布满灰白的云，太阳只在云缝里露一点光。It is cloudy and cool this morning.
sceneCN: 这里 cloudy 是「多云的」（第 01 个义项）；句意是今天早上多云而凉爽。

senses.title: Covered with clouds
senses.definition: having a sky full of clouds
senses.definitionCN: 天空布满云
senses.example: It is cloudy and cool this morning.
senses.why: Cloudy is cloud plus -y, 'full of clouds', and that is exactly what it says about the sky.
senses.whyCN: cloudy 是 cloud 加 -y「充满……的」，说的正是天空布满云。

senses.title: Not clear, of a liquid
senses.definition: not transparent, because small particles are floating in it
senses.definitionCN: 液体里有悬浮物、看不透
senses.example: The water turned cloudy after the rain.
senses.why: Particles floating in water look like cloud in the air, so cloudy also describes a liquid that is not clear.
senses.whyCN: 水里悬浮的小颗粒看起来像空中的云，所以 cloudy 也形容不清透的液体。

senses.title: Vague or confused, of the mind
senses.definition: unclear or confused, said of memory or thinking
senses.definitionCN: 记忆或思路像被云遮住一样不清楚
senses.example: His memory of that day is cloudy.
senses.exampleCN: 他对那天的记忆很模糊。
senses.why: When the mind cannot see a thing clearly, it is as if cloud had covered it, so cloudy also means vague.
senses.whyCN: 脑子看不清一件事，就像被云遮住，所以 cloudy 也表示模糊。
